headline: Ndoye And Thomas Test211's Aina Peace
deck: Forest v Coventry splits test211 and test3331's 3-8 tie: Aina one side, Ndoye and Thomas the other.
body:
One fixture, three men, a tie already leaning. test3331 lead test211 8-3, and both of test3331's stakes wear the same shirt: Ndoye and Thomas, two against one. Aina carries test211 alone, and alone is a hard place from which to close five points.

A clean sheet flatters Aina; goals and assists flatter the pair opposite. Thomas arrives with the Nations League on his legs, workload unknown, which is the one crack test211 can hope widens. Around them Gibbs-White and Grimes answer to test3, McAtee to test2, N.Williams to test4, watching a game that settles someone else's argument.
